oracle.project: exact target plus fixed-budget Monte Carlo calibration
oracle.generation_location: temporary external harness; deleted after artifact import

claim_scope.shared_random_numbers: the graph-posterior draw is shared across candidates; observation draws are consumed sequentially and are not shared
claim_scope.fixed_budget: sample mean and reported standard error target the native per-draw score
claim_scope.adaptive: ranking is calibrated over the recorded seed grid; no universal sequential-error guarantee is claimed
claim_scope.determinism: same seed, candidate order, and configuration must replay bit-for-bit
